name: yolo
description: Agent skills for Ultralytics YOLO — the ultralytics Python package and yolo CLI: model selection, datasets, training, hyperparameter tuning, inference/tracking, Solutions, and export/deployment.

interface.shortDescription: Train, tune, run, and deploy YOLO models
interface.longDescription: Skills covering the full Ultralytics computer-vision lifecycle: dataset preparation and validation, model selection (YOLO26/YOLO11/YOLOv8, YOLO-World, YOLOE, SAM, RT-DETR), training and fine-tuning, hyperparameter tuning, inference and tracking, prebuilt Solutions, and export to ONNX/TensorRT/CoreML/OpenVINO and NPU formats.
